body:
All four items in this issue now appear to be on `main` (665fc18):

1. Streaming: #469 added Anthropic SSE events for `/v1/messages`. `docs/SERVER.md` lists `message_start`, the `content_block_*` events, `message_delta`, `message_stop` and an `error` event.
2. Tools: #469 maps custom `tools[].input_schema` and `tool_choice` (`auto`, `any`, `tool`, `none`) onto the Chat tool path, with `tool_use` output and `tool_result` input blocks. #510 added images in `tool_result`.
3. Tests: `tests/functional/messages_tools.py` covers buffered and streamed tool turns (#469). `tests/functional/cache_messages_loop.py` replays Messages tool history against the cache (#490). `tests/functional/claude_code_agent.py` replays real Claude Code sessions (#521).
4. Docs: `docs/SERVER.md` no longer says Messages rejects tools or streaming. It now reads "Anthropic Messages supports text, images and custom tools", and the endpoint table says "buffered or SSE".

If nothing else is pending, this issue could be closed. Open follow-ups on the same endpoint are tracked separately (#522 / #523, #524).

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope: source and git history reading only (`git log`, `grep` on `main`). No tests were run for this comment and no model was loaded.
